description:
DAO Proposal Preview: decoded targets, proposal state, votes and timelock delay for one OpenZeppelin Governor proposal on Ethereum or Base. Check this first.  Returns: a DAO proposal preview on one OpenZeppelin Governor proposal: the decoded targets and call data the buyer posts, the proposal state, vote totals, quorum and timelock delay read from the chain, and whether each target is verified. No verdict, no model.

GET https://api.arysphere.com/v1/ventures/x402_q_verdict_v1/dao_proposal_preview. Same payment terms as that HTTP route.
Call once with no payment. The result is the payment terms. Retry the same call with the signed payment at _meta["x402/payment"].
name: x402_q_verdict_v1__dao_proposal_preview
